meta.source: Langara College Brand Guidelines 2025 + ARC logo (supplied by ARC)

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Langara orange, PMS 166C. The primary brand colour: "we own the orange". Lead with it. Text on it is black (6.2:1). White text on it passes only at 24px+ (3.4:1); never use white for small text on orange.

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: Secondary, PMS 144C. Fills and illustration accents; black text on it (9.0:1).

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Secondary, PMS 1235C. Fills, highlights, and a chart colour on dark grounds; black text on it (12.1:1). Too light for text or thin marks on white.

tokens.name: brand-sand
tokens.usage: Secondary, PMS 7507C. Soft tint for highlighted rows, selected states and Active badges; black text on it (14.8:1).

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Primary brand black. Text on orange, gold and sand.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Primary brand white.

tokens.name: brand-grey-75
tokens.usage: Secondary grey (75% black). Muted text on white (6.0:1) and light grey.

tokens.name: brand-grey-30
tokens.usage: Secondary grey (30% black). Muted text on dark grounds (10.0:1 on surface-dark).

tokens.name: brand-grey-10
tokens.usage: Secondary grey (10% black). Hairlines and sunken panels on light.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: The ARC logo's wordmark grey. Dark blocks and the Completed badge on light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Light: admin panel, web, and panels on the bright TV. Dark: the TV's after-hours screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, tables and inputs, one step above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, photo placeholders, bar-chart tracks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (17:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, helper text, table headers. 5.5:1 on light surface, 8.8:1 on dark surface-raised.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons (3:1+ against surface-raised).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions, the current slide, progress, key highlights. One strong orange per view.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Always black, per the brand's contrast grid.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and links on surfaces, and the brand's orange subheads. Light uses a deepened orange (5.0:1 on surface) because Langara orange on white is 3.4:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, current step, soft highlight. Ink on it: 13:1 light, 14.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline with a 2px offset (3.1:1+ against both surfaces).

tokens.name: status-active-bg
tokens.usage: Active grant badge background.

tokens.name: status-active-fg
tokens.usage: Active grant badge text (14.8:1 light, 10.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-completed-bg
tokens.usage: Completed grant badge background. Differs from Active in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: status-completed-fg
tokens.usage: Completed grant badge text (11.7:1 light, 11.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: status-pending-fg
tokens.usage: Pending badge text, outlined with line-strong on surface-raised.

tokens.name: status-archived-bg
tokens.usage: Archived badge background.

tokens.name: status-archived-fg
tokens.usage: Archived badge text (4.9:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: FUNCTIONAL, not a brand colour. Form and import errors, destructive actions. 6.6:1 on white, 7.2:1 on dark raised.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: FUNCTIONAL. Error row and banner backgrounds; danger text on it 5.4:1 light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: FUNCTIONAL, not a brand colour. Confirmations and completed import steps.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: FUNCTIONAL. Success banner backgrounds.

tokens.name: area-natural-products
tokens.usage: Natural Products Innovation in charts, dots and legends.

tokens.name: area-data-analytics
tokens.usage: Data Analytics and Bioinformatics in charts, dots and legends.

tokens.name: area-social-innovation
tokens.usage: Social Innovation in charts, dots and legends. Light uses a deepened gold (4.9:1 on white) because brand gold is too light there. The three area colours differ in lightness, so they stay distinct without colour vision.

styles.name: tv-title
styles.usage: Slide title. Sentence case, ends with a period.

styles.name: tv-card-title
styles.sample: Feral hops for B.C.’s microbrewing industry
styles.usage: Grant and post titles on slides, two lines at most.

styles.name: tv-body
styles.usage: Smallest running text on the TV.

styles.name: tv-subhead
styles.usage: Uppercase subheads, the brand's TheSans subhead style. Never smaller than 22px on a TV.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title. Sentence case with a closing period, per the brand's headline rule.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Longer reading copy: post bodies, descriptions, help pages. Adelle is the brand's body face.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Practical information: table cells, form values, menus. TheSans is the brand's practical-information face.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Uppercase subheads and table headers. In accent-text or ink-muted.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Changes appear on the TV within 2 minutes.

styles.name: url
styles.usage: Call-to-action URLs, lowercase, per the brand.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form field gaps, table cell padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), grid gaps in admin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, section gaps in admin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding in admin; gaps between TV cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large section breaks; TV vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: TV top margin.

tokens.name: tv-margin
tokens.usage: TV side margins: keeps content inside the TV's safe area.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, admin cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Tables, panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: TV cards and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, funder chips, slide pager.
